comment: Perfboard layout by storyboardist with underside view, colour wiring diagram and etched PCB; counted from the populated board, confirmed on the diagram. A BTDR-2 reverb module (6 pins) plugs into the board; the TO-92 regulator is marked only I/G/O on the board and 7805 on the diagram.
